title: National Dental Nurse Training Programme of Ireland
text: Lectures on microbiology, infection, immunology and vaccination for dental nurses in training on the national programme, linking lab science to infection prevention in the dental clinic. About the programme

title: Undergraduate dental education
text:
Derek Sullivan is Director of Undergraduate Teaching and Learning at the School of Dental Science, Trinity College Dublin.

Lab members also facilitate problem-based learning (PBL) tutorials, where small groups of students work through clinical and scientific cases.
who: Derek Sullivan · Abed Alkarem Abu Al Haija (PBL, 2024 – March 2026)

title: PhD and postdoctoral training
text: The lab trains PhD students and postdoctoral researchers in fungal and bacterial molecular genetics, genomics and antimicrobial resistance.
